drivingQuestion: Why is the High Priest's chamber called the Chamber of Parhedrin rather than Balvatei?
outcomeNote: R' Yehuda's answer (the name changed) opens the next unit, yoma.sugya007

segments.he: לְלִשְׁכַּת פַּרְהֶדְרִין. תַּנְיָא רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: וְכִי לִשְׁכַּת פַּרְהֶדְרִין הָיְתָה? וַהֲלֹא לִשְׁכַּת בָּלְווֹטֵי הָיְתָה!
segments.en: § Having discussed the obligation to sequester the High Priest prior to Yom Kippur, the Gemara interprets the next matter in the mishna: The High Priest is removed from his house «to the Chamber of Parhedrin. It was taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yehuda» said: «And was it» called «the Chamber of Parhedrin,» the chamber for the annual royal appointees? «Wasn’t it» called «the Chamber of Balvatei,» the chamber for ministers and council heads?
